summary: Comprehensive AI Builder Contest polish pass. Visited every primary screen in both Creator and Gamer lanes (1280x900 + 390x844). Lane toggle, nav re-labelling, Gamer Tracks → Battle Stage, 16-pad sampler, FX/BPM/Search, Connect → Battle Hub, Personal Studio (correct present/absent test-ids), Profile dashboards, Pricing, Backstage Cinema, console hygiene — all exercised. App is in great shape: 0 page errors, 0 new console errors vs iteration_32 baseline, theme is consistently Neon Orange / Electric Green on dark across all visited screens. Three issues to flag for the main agent — see action_items.

ui_bugs.issue: No 'backstage-watch-{id}' buttons exist because the seed DB has 0 recordings in the Kept/Discarded tabs. The 9-phase BackstageCinema sequence therefore could not be exercised end-to-end. The Pending tab renders the empty state correctly. Code-review of BackstagePage.js + BackstageCinema.js shows the wiring is present; this is a data-only gap.

There is no entry point to /backstage from the CREATOR lane BottomNav (creator nav = Discover/Connect/Studio/Record/Profile, no Backstage). Backstage is only reachable in the GAMER lane via nav-backstage. The contest brief asks reviewers to 'switch to creator lane, navigate to backstage page' — currently impossible without a deep link. Either add a Backstage shortcut on Profile/Record for creators, or update copy in the brief.

The 'Stadium VIP & Pro Plans · From $2.98' tile on the Profile screen is NOT clickable and does not navigate anywhere. /pricing, /#/pricing, /plans, /buy all return the default home shell (no pricing-page mount). The $79.98 AUD 'Ownership' hero card the brief mentions is not reachable from any CTA. Stripe gate cannot be smoke-tested.
ui_bugs.selector: tile around 'Stadium VIP & Pro Plans' on social-profile

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking nav-record at 390x844, the [data-testid='stadium-studio'] root is not rendered (test selector returns null). Either the page uses a different root testid on mobile, or the layout fails to mount the main panel at narrow widths. Needs visual confirmation — the most layout-sensitive screen per the brief.

issues: The 'notes' radar visualization on the right uses cyan rgb(0,225,255) accent dots — this is the only non-theme color encountered in the entire pass. All other accents are correctly #FF6B00 / #39FF14. Consider re-tinting the cyan note markers to electric green for theme consistency.

Hub renders Register, Tournament (Q2·2026), Leaderboard and Archive — all clear and unambiguous (no placeholder text). NOTE: there is no separate 'Queue' card; the brief asked for a Queue card (data-testid='battle-queue-card') but the current design fuses Register + auto-match into one card. Update brief expectations OR add a visible queue/wait-state card.

test_results_detail.T1.theme_consistency: PASS — Across Discover, Connect, BattleHub, Studio (KoalaStudio), Record (StadiumStudio), Profile (creator + gamer), Battle Arena, Gamer Tracks, Gamer Stage, Backstage — all accent colors are rgb(255,107,0) / rgb(57,255,20) on dark surfaces. Single exception: cyan rgb(0,225,255) note dots on GamerStage notes panel.
test_results_detail.T2.lane_toggle: PASS — lane-toggle-creator/gamer both flip instantly. Creator BottomNav = Discover/Connect/Studio/Record/Profile. Gamer BottomNav = Battle Stage/Tracks/Backstage/Profile. Labels swap correctly.
test_results_detail.T3.gamer_tracks_to_battle_stage: PASS — gamer-tracks-page renders 5 catalog-battle-{i} buttons. Clicking catalog-battle-0 → gamer-stage opens with title 'Pink Pony Club / Bring the fire inside', toast 'Battle created!' fires, 0 new console errors during transition. Screenshot 09_gamer_stage.png.
test_results_detail.T4.cinematic_backstage: BLOCKED-BY-EMPTY-SEED — backstage-page renders, tabs pending_review/kept/discarded all work, but 0 recordings exist in any tab. backstage-watch-{id} buttons therefore not present. Cinema sequence not exercisable end-to-end without seed data. Code path looks correct.
test_results_detail.T5a.16_pad_sampler: PASS — Correct testid is studio-pad-{0..15} (not pad-{i} as the brief stated). All 16 pads found in studio-pad-grid. studio-pad-0 click registers (orange active glow visible).
test_results_detail.T5b.studio_search: PASS — search overlay opens, query 'drum' returns results.
test_results_detail.T5c.studio_fx: PASS — studio-fx-stutter / crush / reverb / delay / pitch toggles present; studio-fx-amount slider present; studio-holdfx-bar present.
test_results_detail.T5d.sequencer: PARTIAL — BPM input accepts 140. No data-testid='sequencer-play' or 'studio-play' found; could not directly verify the live step indicator via testid. Recommend adding data-testid='sequencer-play' and 'sequencer-step-indicator' for testability.
test_results_detail.T6.battle_hub: PASS w/ NOTE — battle-hub root + battle-register-card + battle-tournament-card + battle-leaderboard-card (with leader-row-0..8) + battle-archive (with archive-row-{uuid} and archive-vote-a/b-{uuid}) all present. Wording is clear. No 'battle-queue-card' (see design_issues).
test_results_detail.T7.personal_studio_clean: PASS — All 3 required-PRESENT testids exist (studio-tools-panel, stem-file-input, ai-beat-generate, stem-mixer). All 7 required-ABSENT testids confirmed removed (stadium-chat-feed, fan-level-tracker, stadium-video-call-btn, stadium-voice-call-btn, fire-count, heart-count, say-something-input). Personal Studio is free of social distractions as required.
test_results_detail.T8.stripe_ownership_gate: FAIL — Pricing page not reachable via any tried route (/pricing, /#/pricing, /plans, /buy). No pricing-page testid mounted. Profile 'Stadium VIP & Pro Plans' tile is non-interactive. $79.98 AUD Ownership card not visible anywhere. Stripe gate cannot be smoke-tested. See ui_bugs.
test_results_detail.T9.console_hygiene: PASS — 0 page errors. 1 pre-existing console error: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning (same as iteration_31/32 baseline — NOT a regression). 1 benign Canvas2D willReadFrequently warning from the notes visualization. No duplicate-key warnings, no new prop-type warnings.
test_results_detail.T10.profile_stats: PASS — social-profile + profile-card + profile-stats + stat-wins/stat-losses/stat-likes/stat-views + profile-battle-status + profile-register-cta + profile-playlists + profile-my-raps all render with 0 values. No crash on empty state. Brief said 'battle-stats / playlists-row / my-raps' — actual testids are 'profile-stats / profile-playlists / profile-my-raps'.
test_results_detail.T11.mobile_stadium_studio_390x844: FAIL — On 390x844 mobile viewport, after clicking nav-record, [data-testid='stadium-studio'] is NOT present. Other creator nav tabs render fine on mobile. Needs root-cause investigation (mobile-only conditional render?).

action_items: Make the Pricing page reachable — add a route + a clickable CTA on the 'Stadium VIP & Pro Plans' tile on Profile. Render $79.98 AUD Ownership hero card with data-testid='pricing-ownership-card' and a 'Buy Once' CTA (data-testid='pricing-buy-once'). Required for the Stripe smoke test.
Fix mobile (390x844) rendering of StadiumStudio — [data-testid='stadium-studio'] not mounted at narrow width. Likely a conditional/min-width gate.

Backstage cinema can only be tested with seeded recordings. Either (a) seed at least 1 Kept recording in dev DB, or (b) add a 'demo cinematic' button on Backstage that runs BackstageCinema with a fixture for QA.
Add a Backstage shortcut for the CREATOR lane (Profile or Record screen) so creators can access their archive without switching to gamer.
Re-tint cyan note dots on GamerStage notes panel from rgb(0,225,255) to electric green (#39FF14) for strict theme consistency.
Add data-testid='sequencer-play' and 'sequencer-step-indicator' on KoalaStudio for testability.
Pre-existing hydration warning '<span> in <option>' is still emitted (carried from iteration_31). Worth fixing for clean console at contest demo time.
critical_code_review_comments: Brief vs reality mismatch: brief asks for testids 'pad-{i}', 'battle-queue-card', 'battle-stats', 'playlists-row', 'my-raps', 'backstage-watch-{id}'. Actual testids: 'studio-pad-{i}', 'battle-tournament-card', 'profile-stats', 'profile-playlists', 'profile-my-raps', no watch buttons (empty seed). Recommend brief is updated to match implementation OR testids renamed to match the brief (cheaper to update brief).
PricingPage.js exists in /app/frontend/src/pages/ but appears not registered in the router (no route serves it). Either add the route in ViewRouter.js or drop the file.
GamerStage notes visualization uses cyan accents that violate the strict 2-color theme policy. Easy fix in the visualization component.
Backstage discoverability: Creator lane has no nav-backstage entry. If Backstage is meant to be cross-lane, add it; if gamer-only, that should be documented.
Mobile StadiumStudio not mounting at 390x844 is a real regression — needs the main agent to investigate the responsive guard.

success_rate.frontend: 9/11 fully PASS, 1 BLOCKED (Backstage cinema — empty seed), 1 FAIL (Pricing route + mobile StadiumStudio)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing DB: 13 active battles, 5 gamer-catalog battles, 9-entry leaderboard, 3 archived bouts. Backstage tabs (Kept/Discarded) are empty — needs seed for full cinema test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_33 is a contest-readiness polish pass. App is otherwise stable. KEY TESTID MAP DISCOVERED THIS RUN: pads are 'studio-pad-{0..15}' (NOT 'pad-{i}'); profile stats are 'profile-stats' + 'stat-wins/losses/likes/views' (NOT 'battle-stats'); battle hub uses 'battle-register-card', 'battle-tournament-card', 'battle-leaderboard-card' (NO 'battle-queue-card'); backstage is only in gamer nav. PricingPage.js is orphaned (no route). Mobile StadiumStudio doesn't mount at 390px. Next pass should validate fixes for: pricing route, mobile stadium, cyan→green re-tint on GamerStage notes, and creator-lane Backstage shortcut.
rca of the issue: Pricing not reachable: PricingPage.js exists at /app/frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.js but ViewRouter.js does not register a 'pricing' view, and no UI element has an onClick that sets view to 'pricing'.
